grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are who you say you are before updating your driving licence address

grants.description: Access your current driving licence details from DVLA records
grants.purpose: To verify your current licence details and eligibility to update the address

grants.description: Submit your new address to update DVLA records
grants.purpose: To update your driving licence with your new address and send the new licence to this location

grants.description: Provide addresses you've lived at in the last 3 years
grants.purpose: Legal requirement for DVLA to maintain accurate address history for licence holders

revocation.mechanism: Contact DVLA or revoke through your GOV.UK account before registration is complete
revocation.effect: Address update will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. You remain legally obligated to update your address within 3 months of moving.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot change your name. Agent cannot apply for photo changes that require payment. Agent must confirm all address details with you before submission. Agent cannot override eligibility requirements.
